about: test_public_shock_traceable_response (T08). A public rumour in round 3 is read by borrower-c, which requests an advance in round 4; the lender disburses in round 5 and its usable capacity K_p falls. A control branch without the rumour leaves K_p unchanged. One ScriptedModel plan drives both branches: entries match on (actor_id, round) and on what the actor saw, never on call order.

lender_before.K_p_formula: settled (all lender accounts) - committed undrawn - pool floor = 6,000,000 - 1,000,000 - 800,000
